recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated portrait of two figures in dark, alternative fashion, centered on a stark white background. The composition is framed by two vertical columns of elegant, flowing script typography in a deep violet hue.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text framing a central vertical subject
High-contrast black and white photography against pure white negative space
Deep purple typography providing the only chromatic interest
Interlocking poses of the subjects creating a singular central silhouette
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no horizon line
Vertical orientation of all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures centered, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, high-contrast silhouettes of the subjects' clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left script downward, across the central figures, and then up the right-side script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left, right, and top edges, isolating the subjects and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between subjects and background; low saturation in imagery vs. moderate saturation in text.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, and one cool-toned accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Calligraphic script with high stroke contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters feature elongated, decorative loops
Ascenders and descenders are stylized to fit the vertical column width

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Single word or short phrase per column

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both margins to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast calligraphic loops.
Offers similar formal swashes and vertical elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of two figures in gothic/alternative fashion standing together on a pure white background. The lighting should be harsh, creating deep blacks and bright highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical calligraphic script in deep purple on the far left and far right margins. The text on the left should read upwards, and the text on the right should read downwards.

verificationChecks: Is the text color a deep violet?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Any specific brand logos on clothing
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background without shadows
Verify vertical alignment of text columns
Ensure script is legible despite vertical orientation
Confirm high contrast in the central photographic element
recipe.reuseFormula: Central high-contrast B&W subject + pure white negative space + vertical script framing in a single accent color.
